data.context: In *The business environment of patenting firms in Australia* (2024), this passage reports a result from the regression analysis of patenting and total R&D expenditure. Using Australian businesses observed in IPLORD and surveyed in BERD across survey years from 2011 to 2020, it states that the percentage of R&D funds from the business’s own resources is significantly negatively correlated with the number of granted patents.
